about_the_game:
The aim of the creation of this game was to simulate a calming nature enviroment where one can look at trees and listen to the sounds of nature, without the need to be aware of one's surroundings, like in an action game.

This game is made for those who cannot go to a forest in real life, whether that is because you live in a city or perhaps your country has a long winter, like mine has and there is no green color to be found outside for months. Green colors and calming sounds can make for a therapeutic experience. This could also be a good game to use when you want to introduce an older person to the world of videogames.

Features a configurable weather system with easy control options.

While the game was designed with clear skies, fog or light rain in mind, there are other options as well. You can configure the volume of the birds, weather and music.

The game was designed to be played with the high graphics settings, and looks quite bad on the lower settings. Fps doesn’t matter much though (at least for me), as nothing really happens in the game. The game consists of three maps and their graphically lower variants.

A disclaimer though: this game is a standing still simulator that demands quite a lot from your computer. 

There is no goal nor exitement. Absolutely nothing will happen (unless you tweak the weather and cause a thunderstorm or jump off the edge or something...).  If you seek action games, look elsewhere. The sole purpose of this game is to be pleasant to look at and have a calm feeling to it.

name: Calming Forest

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit operating system, or newer
  • Processor: Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-6700K CPU @ 4.00GHz
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1070
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: These are the specs of the computer that this game was developed on. On HIGH settings game will run at approximately 12-25fps.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit operating system, or newer
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 9 7900X3D, 4.4 GHz, 12-Core
  • Memory: 32 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4070
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: 60fps on high settings.

short_description: Relax in a calming forest for a moment. Look upon giant trees, pretty little flowers and a lush forest, while listening to birds singing and rain falling. No exitement, no rush, no surprises... just serenity.
